Since 1938

Kokomo’s protective local secret

A working-class institution.

Factory workers at lunch. Retirees who know their order by heart. Families bringing the next generation through the door. Artie’s has served Kokomo breakfast and lunch since 1938.

No trends and no pretense — just daily hand-breading, generous portions, familiar faces, and a place that still feels like it belongs to the neighborhood.
